text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Good!
As expected, you've got great talent!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"When Trainer gets here, let's have them check out your form!
They'll definitely heap praise on you♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart's first three years—
she faced various hardships along the way,
but she overcame every single one of them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—All right, let's do our best today too.
The menu is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart's training continues.
Facing it stoically without compromising a single day—
for she cannot survive any other way.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, apparently this year's Tiara contenders are on fire!
I heard a bunch of super talented girls are competing.”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The Tiara route, huh... Speaking of which, Heart-san is entering another race, right?
—Man, that generation was fiery too~.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
choice_data_list: Have you recovered from the fatigue of the last race?
Have you recovered from the fatigue of the last race?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You bet! ...is what I'd like to say.
I might still be feeling a little sluggish."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's getting harder to shake off fatigue...
Time really is cruel, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Still, you're going to train, right?
Still, you're going to train, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You bet! Of course.
This is one thing I just can't give up on."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
choice_data_list: ...Aren't you going to call out to her?
...Aren't you going to call out to her?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
My mind is already made up.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Pushing relentlessly down this harsh road—
To connect these cherished days to the future.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Right!
Let's do our best today, too!
